== Course of events ==

The farewell comes in the wake of the party's clash with the Nome King, in which the Scarecrow used Billina's poisonous eggs to let Dorothy seize the King's magic belt, and after Billina's revelation freed the Tin Woodman from his enchanted trap. With these trials past, Dorothy bids farewell to her friends in Oz. Among them is Billina, who chooses to remain in Oz rather than go on with Dorothy.

Dorothy herself is then carried away to Australia, where she finds Uncle Henry recovering from illness, and she stays to comfort him as he mends. In the events that follow, Ozma's magic picture is used to check on Aunt Em and on Uncle Henry in Australia, the magic belt passes to Ozma, and Ozma's own homecoming is celebrated.
